item.title: Workout reminders keep the right routine
item.summary: When you report a set after a new workout reminder, Murph can use that reminder’s saved routine instead of letting an earlier workout that was left open block it.
item.details: This works in an ordinary private-chat reply without requiring the iMessage Reply feature. Murph still stops when the routine, set, timing, or active-workout state is ambiguous, and explicit corrections to an older workout stay attached to that workout.
